# The repository's labels: name | color | description. Issue forms may add only these (Test-IssueForms.ps1);
# GitHub drops a label the repository does not define. Create or update with:
#   gh label create "<name>" --color <color> --description "<description>" --force
# Type
bug | d73a4a | Something does not work as documented
enhancement | a2eeef | A better version of existing behavior
feature | 0e8a16 | New capability, accepted from Discussions
documentation | 0075ca | Documentation is wrong, missing or unclear
question | d876e3 | An open design question or proposal awaiting a decision
security | b60205 | A security hardening change (vulnerabilities are reported privately)
chore | ededed | Maintenance with no behavior change
# Triage
needs-triage | fbca04 | Not yet reviewed by a maintainer
duplicate | cfd3d7 | This issue or pull request already exists
invalid | e4e669 | This doesn't seem right
wontfix | ffffff | This will not be worked on (the closing comment says why)
good first issue | 7057ff | Small and self-contained, with the steps in the issue
help wanted | 008672 | Larger work where help is welcome
# Intake (maintainers set accepted; the PR intake workflow keeps the issue:* labels on pull requests)
accepted | 0e8a16 | Agreed by a maintainer; a pull request may implement it
issue:accepted | 0e8a16 | Pull request: closes an accepted issue
issue:awaiting-acceptance | fbca04 | Pull request: closes an issue not yet accepted
issue:none | d73a4a | Pull request: closes no issue
# Gate overrides (maintainers only)
linked-issue:late | c5def5 | Gate · Linked issue: the closed issue may be newer than the pull request
docs:not-needed | c5def5 | Review checks: this library change needs no docs-site pull request
# Automation
dependencies | 0366d6 | Pull requests that update a dependency file
automated | ededed | Opened by automation
release | 5319e7 | Release automation
github-actions | 000000 | Pull requests that update GitHub Actions code
nuget | 004cc4 | Pull requests that update NuGet packages
javascript | 168700 | Pull requests that update JavaScript code
